title: Most people feel overwhelmed by the news, not informed.
body:
It is easy to blame the algorithm for this. We scroll through endless feeds, trying to separate signal from noise, but we often end up exhausted instead of smarter. The problem is not just the volume of information. The problem is that most news feeds treat everyone exactly the same.

True intelligence is not about reading everything. It is about reading the right things for your specific life, career, and curiosity. When you filter out the noise that does not matter to you, you actually have the time to understand the stories that do.

This is where AI changes the game. It should not be used to create echo chambers or push outrage. It should be a tool that respects your time by curating a briefing that is actually relevant to you. Personalization is simply the difference between drowning in data and having a clear view of the world.

I am curious how you keep up. Do you feel like you are getting the full picture, or are you just catching headlines as they fly by?
